intro.h2: Tile done right, explained step by step
paragraphs: Aguirre's Tile Services does tile installation in Forney for homeowners who want it done once and done right. The work covers all types of tile floors, bath tubs, walk-in showers, backsplashes, walls and fireplaces. Backsplash installation is the job reviewers mention most, in 12 Google reviews so far.

Most reviews are about Manny. He explains the whole process before he starts, gives straight advice on the best options and goes out of his way to finish on time. Two reviewers end the same way: they will call him again for their next tile job. You choose the tile, and Aguirre's handles the rest.

services.h2: Tile installation in Forney, room by room

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: Backsplash installation is the most reviewed job on Aguirre's Google profile, with 12 reviews about it. One reviewer praised Manny's work replacing an old kitchen backsplash. Recent work includes a white geometric tile backsplash behind white upper and dark lower cabinets.

image.alt: Kitchen with white upper cabinets, dark lower cabinets, white counters and a white geometric tile backsplash

items.name: Walk-in showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers with large-format wall tile, built-in niches and mosaic accents. One recent shower uses gray stone-look tile in a staggered pattern with two mosaic-lined niches. Another is finished floor to ceiling in brick-look tile with glass corner shelves.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with large gray stone-look tile in a staggered pattern, mosaic niches and a black valve

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: All types of tile floors, from large marble-look planks to patterned cement-look tile, gray porcelain and herringbone layouts. One Facebook before and after shows a kitchen floor covered in broken old tile, then finished in white marble-look planks.

image.alt: Large gray marble-look porcelain floor tile with straight grout lines in a bathroom

items.name: Bathroom tile replacement
items.blurb: Tired bathroom floors and tub surrounds replaced with clean marble-look tile. Michelle had the tile in her second bathroom replaced, and Michael had his bathroom floor tile redone. Both said Manny explained the process and finished the project on time.

image.alt: Tub surround tiled in large white marble-look porcelain tile above a white alcove tub

items.name: Fireplaces and accent walls
items.blurb: Tile is not just for kitchens and baths. Aguirre's lists fireplaces among its services, along with tiled walls. If you want a fireplace surround or a feature wall refreshed, ask about it when you book your estimate and bring a sample of the look you like.

about.text: Aguirre's Tile Services is a tile contractor on University Drive in Forney, Texas. Tile is the focus: floors, bath tubs, walk-in showers, backsplashes, walls, fireplaces and more. Manny is the name you will see in review after review. Clients call him punctual, professional and a great communicator who gives excellent advice. The approach is simple: you choose the tile and the design, and Aguirre's takes care of the rest, from tearing out the old tile to setting the new. Several clients say they will call again.

service_area.text: Aguirre's Tile Services is based on University Drive in Forney, Texas, and Forney is the town it names on its Google and Facebook pages. Forney homeowners can call for a free in-home estimate. If you live nearby and are not sure whether you are in range, call (214) 407-2403 with your address and a short description of the project, and the team will let you know.

items.a: Yes. Aguirre's Tile Services offers free estimates. The company sends its flooring expert to your home to measure the area to be tiled and gives you a free estimate on the project. If you approve it, your installation is scheduled. Call (214) 407-2403 to set it up.

items.q: What kinds of tile work do you do?
items.a: All types of tile floors, bath tubs, walk-in showers, backsplashes, walls and fireplaces. Kitchen backsplashes are the job mentioned most in Google reviews, and reviewers also mention herringbone patterns, shower remodels and bathroom floor tile replacement. If your project involves tile, ask about it.

items.q: Will you remove my old tile?
items.a: Yes. Tile replacement jobs start with tearing out the old tile, as in the before and after photos of a kitchen floor where broken old tile covered the room before new marble-look planks went down. Manny explains each step before work starts.

items.q: How long will my project take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the job, so ask for a timeline when your space is measured. Reviewers say Manny finished on time as promised, and one noted he went out of his way to finish the project on schedule.

Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM, and Saturday, 9 AM to 12 PM. Closed Sunday. Saturday mornings are a good time to call if you work during the week. Call (214) 407-2403 to book your free in-home estimate.
